a.lede: DHSC to extend US tech firm’s contract for two more years to allow time to line up British companies to replace it Ministers will end the NHS’s contract with the controversial tech firm Palantir – but not until 2029, to allow time to line up British companies to replace it. The Department of Health and Social Care (DHSC) has decided
a.title: Ministers to end Palantir’s contract with NHS in England in 2029

b.lede: Despite calls from some Labour MPs to end the arrangement with Palantir, ministers say a new contract will not be awarded until 2029.
b.title: NHS data contract to stay with Palantir until 2029
